data.content_ref: inline:The self-refutation condition is internally inconsistent with the named relation. SRC_002 declares a contradiction, but its REFUTED-IF condition attacks the wrong failure mode: it says the relation is refuted if 14ab0ddd3b5e 'explicitly acknowledges the underdetermination as a caveat rather than resolving it.' But acknowledging a tension and then resolving it is still a contradiction (the two positions are opposed even if the artifact notes it); it is not the same as the two being 'compatible.' The actual refutation for a contradiction would be if 14ab0ddd3b5e ALSO treated the linear model as empirically assumed (not domain-entailed), making the two compatible/aligned. By framing refutation as mere acknowledgement + caveat rather than actual co-existence, the clause cannot reliably distinguish a surviving contradiction from a dissolved one, leaving the proposed relation logically under-defended.
